desc_en: Krishna's 700-verse dialogue with Arjuna — the essence of the Upanishads.
desc_ne: अर्जुनसँग श्रीकृष्णको ७०० श्लोके संवाद — उपनिषद्हरूको सार।

Rig, Sama, Yajur, Atharva — the oldest mantras, including Gayatri.
